S01: At the height of his glory, Hercules received yet another unusual command.
S02: From the balcony of his palace, Eurystheus watched him with a mixture of fear and contempt.
S03: Between his fingers was written the order for the golden apples.
S04: Eurystheus: "Now I want the golden apples from the Garden of the Hesperides."
S05: In the courtyard, Hercules raised his head without flinching.
S06: The garden was a hidden sanctuary, but his feet already carried him down the road.
S07: Behind a golden curtain of leaves hid the garden dedicated to Hera.
S08: Every apple glowed with an inner ember.
S09: But the garden had its guardian — and he did not sleep.
S10: From the shadow uncoiled its enormous body.
S11: Hercules did not retreat a single step.
S12: His arrow was tipped with the deadly poison of the Hydra.
S13: With one motion, the bow sang.
S14: The arrow found the beast at once.
S15: The guardian fell, and the garden remained still.
S16: But the wind brought yet another word — of a new task.
S17: Voice: "Come, let me tell you of the final task... you must bring Cerberus."
S18: The deepest entrance to the Underworld already awaited him.
S19: Through the shadows, Hercules descended to the stone gates.
S20: There rose the monster with three throats.
S21: Six eyes looked straight into him.
S22: Hercules clenched his fists — he knew strength alone would not be enough.
S23: The gate opened with a thunder of chains.
S24: Cerberus charged, and the earth shook.
S25: Not with ferocity, but with wit — he seized the beast's collars.
S26: His muscles strained like bronze cables.
S28: With heavy chains, he bound the beast.
S29: And led it upward, toward the light of the world.
S30: Before the gates of Eurystheus, the city fell silent at the wonder.
S31: Eurystheus himself hid in a bronze barrel.
S32: Thus ended also the last, the twelfth labor.
S33: But the true reward was yet to come.
S34: Step by step, the mortal climbed toward Olympus.
S35: At the summit, the palaces of the gods shone without shadows.
S36: Zeus received him with open arms.
S37: The father recognized the strength and worthiness of the son.
S38: All the gods of Olympus gathered for the ceremony.
S39: Hebe, the goddess of youth, descended the stairs.
S41: Zeus: "Today my son becomes part of the heavenly home."
S42: The wedding filled Olympus with light.
S43: The eternal radiance clothed the mortal like a cloak.
S44: No longer mortal — Hercules became a god.
S45: He looked upon the fields and cities that once awaited him.
S46: His name was spoken with reverence beneath the sky.
S47: The face of youth and the face of strength — now one.
S48: And so, on Mount Olympus, ends the tale of Hercules.
